snippet.title: The End of the Sun - PlayStation 5 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: The End of the Sun launches on PlayStation 5 on April 21, 2026. Explore an atmospheric first-person mystery inspired by Slavic folklore, myth, and ritual. Wishlist now on PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017998
